//: Shared settings for goblin-forge's own TypeScript sources.
This is NOT the config Goblin *programs* are compiled with — that base
lives in runtime/tsconfig.base.json and has a very different job.
Written for TypeScript 6.0. Options that are 6.0 defaults (strict,
an ES2015-or-later target, a non-classic moduleResolution) are still
spelled out where they are load-bearing, so a future default flip is a
visible diff rather than a silent loss of checking.
